approval_scope: Synthetic fixture only; real-data adoption requires human approval and a new methodology version.
dissolve: Not used by fixture release. A future live release must union by normalized ID only after duplicate resolution and report before/after counts.

identifier.on_duplicate: exclude every conflicting occurrence and report

null_invalid_unsupported: Null, empty, non-polygonal, or still-invalid geometry fails release; repaired inputs are retained and reported.
population_weighting: Fixture weight is synthetic, same-vintage test data and used only in fixture coverage; it is not population.
slivers: Intersections at or below minimum_area_m2 are reported candidates=false and ignored; no buffer is applied.
